economy.title: Inflation is still hot, fueled in part by the AI boom
economy.summary: The U.S. economy grew at a rapid clip during the summer and early fall, due in part to the artificial intelligence boom. That boom is also fueling higher inflation and rattling the stock market.

economy.title: Many families are cutting corners at the grocery store to pay their other bills
economy.summary: Cash-strapped consumers are changing they way they spend money. As essentials like rent and utility bills gobble up more of their budget, some families are dialing back on groceries or eating out.

science.title: The surprising reason women seem better at multitasking than men
science.summary: Men and women appear to be similarly capable of multitasking, but men are more than twice as likely to ignore conversation while juggling multiple activities. Researchers believe this unexpected difference may help explain why women are widely perceived as better multitaskers.
